title: Function Scope and Shadowing Check
description: Local bindings, shadowing outer names, and leaving outer values unchanged.

questions.explanation: The parameter shadows outer `label` inside `show`. Outside, the outer binding is still `"outer"`.
Assigning to the parameter updates only the local binding. Outer `value` stays `10`.
Locals stay inside the function. Reading `rate` outside throws.
When you do not shadow, the body can read the outer `unit`.
Inside `probe`, `x` is the parameter `"arg"`. Outside, module-level `x` remains `"module"`.
